description: This file defines a ChatLog component for a terminal user interface, managing chat messages, system messages, tool execution states, and message streams. It includes methods for adding, updating, and removing messages and tool components, and for handling state transitions in a chat application.

classes.name: ChatLog
classes.description: A UI component class that manages chat conversation state, including messages, tool executions, and system prompts, within a terminal interface environment.

methods.name: dropComponentReferences
methods.description: Removes references to a component from internal maps, typically when a component is removed from view.

methods.name: pruneOverflow
methods.description: Ensures the number of child components does not exceed the maximum by removing oldest components.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new component to the chat log and prunes overflow if necessary.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all messages and internal state, optionally preserving pending user messages.

methods.name: restorePendingUsers
methods.description: Restores previously pending user messages back into the chat log.

methods.name: clearPendingUsers
methods.description: Removes all pending user messages from the chat log.

methods.name: createSystemMessage
methods.description: Creates a system message container for display.

methods.name: addSystem
methods.description: Adds a system message to the chat log.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a user message to the chat log.

methods.name: addPendingUser
methods.description: Adds a placeholder for a pending user message, tracking its state.

methods.name: commitPendingUser
methods.description: Removes a pending user message from the pending state after completion.

methods.name: dropPendingUser
methods.description: Removes a pending user message without committing it.

methods.name: hasPendingUser
methods.description: Checks if a pending user message with a given run ID exists.

methods.name: reconcilePendingUsers
methods.description: Reconciles pending user messages with history, removing those that match.

methods.name: countPendingUsers
methods.description: Returns the number of pending user messages.

methods.name: resolveRunId
methods.description: Resolves a run ID, defaulting to 'default' if none provided.

methods.name: startAssistant
methods.description: Begins streaming an assistant message, replacing existing if present.

methods.name: updateAssistant
methods.description: Updates the text of an ongoing assistant message.

methods.name: finalizeAssistant
methods.description: Completes an assistant message, finalizing its display.

methods.name: dropAssistant
methods.description: Removes an ongoing assistant message stream.

methods.name: showBtw
methods.description: Displays a 'between' message, possibly indicating a question/answer state.

methods.name: dismissBtw
methods.description: Removes the 'between' message from display.

methods.name: hasVisibleBtw
methods.description: Checks if a 'between' message is currently displayed.

methods.name: startTool
methods.description: Initiates a tool execution component with given arguments.

methods.name: updateToolArgs
methods.description: Updates the arguments for an ongoing tool execution.

methods.name: updateToolResult
methods.description: Updates the result of a tool execution, optionally marking it as an error or partial.

methods.name: setToolsExpanded
methods.description: Expands or collapses all tool components.
